caption:
So you can now make Vox-style collage animations like this using Claude.

without animating a single frame.

This is collage animation, 

the paper-cutout style you see in explainer videos and documentaries,

and Claude can now build it for you inside a real video editor.

So here’s how to do it.

Head over to InVideo’s MCP page and select Claude.

Hit connect, 

Then copy the prompt for your agent and paste it into Claude,

and it will finish the setup by itself.

Now you can drop in your reference folders 
and ask it to make an explainer on any topic you want.

Not only that, it doesn’t just give you a video file.

It builds a full timeline inside invideo timeline that you can edit.

If you want the full setup guide 
drop “AI” in the comments and I’ll send them over.
